generic_sampling_rules.text_columns: Sample from an explicit pool of plausible labels; 10-20% of rows near-variants (case/space/accents) when not enum; empty string allowed only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_int_columns: Uniform integer in the stated range; include boundary values and one step beyond; no NULL for NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_real_columns: Uniform real with two decimals in stated range; include boundary values.
generic_sampling_rules.date_text_columns: Sample dates in the table's shown text format (Month D); keep the table's chronological/order rule.
generic_sampling_rules.null_pattern: For every nullable column, produce at least one NULL row per instance; non-NULL values follow the range/enum/order rules.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates_for_distinct: Ensure 20-50% of rows share a value with another row on the flagged column.
generic_sampling_rules.ties_for_order_limit: Plant at least 2 rows tied at the requested rank (1 or 10) on the ORDER column; if n < rank, tie the top two rows instead.
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary: Ensure at least one group has COUNT(*) values 1,2,3 around the threshold; groups may be NULL-joined; a 0-count group only via LEFT JOIN orphan parents.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_pk: Primary keys are fresh sequential values per instance, unique tuples for composite PKs; never overwrite PK values during planting.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join_rows: Include parent rows with no child rows on the join column (orphan parents), and no NULL FK on NOT NULL child columns.
